Name: Abigail Cat Girl - Abigail Pet
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][b][i][color=#9900ff][size=6][u][center]Abigail Pet[/center][/u][/size][/color][/i][/b]

[b][i][color=#00ffff][size=5][u]Just... why not?[/u][/size][/color][/i][/b]


[size=4][b]Adopt and take care of this cute humanoid creature named Abigail, nobody knows where she comes from but she certainly doesn't behave like a person, and the worst thing? The real Abigail is out there too...
[/b][/size]

[b][i][color=#00ffff][size=6][u]Features of the mod:
[/u][/size][/color][/i][/b]
[/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#ff0000][size=5][b][i][u]Replace the cat with Abigail.[/u][/i][/b][/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b]Erratic behavior.[/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b]Some new animations, such as eating an amethyst... Yes.[/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b]Completely silent... (I couldn't find the sound I'd like her to have so she won't make any sound instead).[/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b]Life partner.[/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b]She also eats stones, keep her away from your stones...[/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b]Objects to customize Abby.[/b][/size][/font]
[/list]
